north_star: Frontier-level problem solving with minimum necessary computation
decision_motivation: Prior P1.5/P2.5/P43/P44/P45 fixed H search failed; test ACTUAL trained weights proposing new typed executable program tokens on independently sourced STRING SyGuS competition rather than reuse ARC grids.

external_original.publication: SyGuS 2018 public string PBE benchmark. All file identities selected from metadata only, not body read in this project except different 4 preflight file examples. Public tasks may appear in other models' pretraining; NEUMANN's student weights trained only on generated synthetic tasks.
external_original.target_scope: 8 pinned independently published original string transformations; one original constraint withheld as TEST and never used by proposal generation. Remaining constraints as TRAIN. Unsupported/non-unary/parse error consumes one denominator and yields ABSTAIN.
external_original.risk_no_universal_proof: PBE original constraints do not certify equivalence on arbitrary strings. Claim only exact heldout original source examples. No Q6 proof from single external string formalism.

model.source_generator: Original NEUMANN experiment trains from scratch on synthetic program data, no external pretrained teacher or weights; train seeds fixed, model emits TWO atom tokens of executable CONCAT(left,right) AST, not a cached whole-program ID or classification. Human-written typed atom alphabet and feature extraction remain limitations.
model.algorithm: Pure numpy two-head trainable normalized-gradient softmax linear token policy, training across 3200 different synthetic tasks, data seed 41677, 120 full-batch gradient steps, no test source bodies.
model.abstract_syntax: Concat(Atom0,Atom1), 15 typed atoms; 225 possible compositions, generated by two learned heads. Classical exhaustive enumeration and classical prefix matching given EXACT SAME 225 programs and original TRAIN source rights.
model.counterfactual: Prior ARC one-seed H does not include any string AST. More important equal-rights classical 225-program full version space is mandatory, so no global novel human-opcode invention claim.
model.checkpoint: Must freeze checksum of actual trained numpy weights AFTER source-free synthetic training and BEFORE ANY original target body is opened. No direct eval workflow may fetch target without pinned checkpoint SHA; first receipt immutable.

evaluation.original_test: last constraint held out from each original input/output file. No original TEST gold passed to model or CEGIS candidate selectors.
evaluation.run_budget: Two candidate execution budgets: learned first 32 vs deterministic classical first 32; full EXACT 225-program classical enumerator separately. Equal grammar, rights, deterministic source test. Measure model inference, training, candidate execution, verification, cold resource cost.
evaluation.positive_early_gate: Only scoped G1 generative learning candidate if >=2 original heldout exact, >=1 over matched classical 32 at 0 added wrong accepted, >=1 correct produced by executable token-pair AST absent from exact training AST examples, frozen checkpoint, and full enumeration plus independent raw-source replay PASS. Even if this gate passes, full classical enumeration may tie and therefore no global Q3/Q4/Q6.
evaluation.negative_gate: If classical full225 solves every learned-solved task or model merely reproduces a weak search ordering, classify as conditional search-efficiency pilot, NOT strong-classical-exclusive structure discovery; real Q3 PASS remains OPEN.
evaluation.declared_limitations: A two-atom human-supplied DSL cannot express every SyGuS string function. Nothing here proves a novel operator outside human grammar or same-rights cvc5 superiority. A trained program-token generator can still be inferior to classical CEGIS.
evaluation.scope_of_blindness: Researcher selected filenames/hash metadata before target body read, but corpus publicly available and benchmark filename hints type.
